intro: Looking Further is an Alliance espionage mission directed by the wizard Theocritus via an enchanted conduit. To investigate tensions between the rogue mage Morganth and the Blackrock orcs, you must infiltrate the watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep and plant an enchanted glyph inside an unnoticed container.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have been watching the Tower of Ilgalar, and can detect that Morganth is in conflict with the Orcs in Stonewatch Keep. I do not know the reason behind their contention, but you may aid me in unraveling this mystery.
Take another Glyph of Azora, then go to the top of the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep.
Find a suitable object on which to place the Glyph. A chest or a jar -- some place where the glyph will not be noticed -- will suit my purpose.

clips.title: Progress
paras: This jar once held a foul-smelling liquor, but now lies empty and forgotten on a pair of barrels.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is a suitable vessel for the Glyph of Azora, allowing Theocritus to delve into the minds within Stonewatch Keep.
